title: Meal result (engine output, web input)
description: One finished meal: {form, picked_idea, recipe, evaluation: {pack, macros}}. Same fields as the personal app's saved meals, without store fields (counts, live_session, auto_matched). Pack lines come from smartbite_engine.pack.

attempts.description: One short summary per recipe attempt.

slug.description: URL name of the meal, e.g. 'greek-chicken-bowl'.

demo.description: True for the pre-built demo meals shown without an API key.

fixture.description: True for hand-made test data, never shown as a real meal.

photo.description: Path of the meal photo, e.g. '/demo/images/<slug>.jpg'.

photo_ai_generated.description: True when the photo was made by an image model; the UI labels it.

items.description: Recipe ingredients scaled to all servings.

budget_check_complete.description: False when some bought line has no price.

prices_estimated.description: Only with a country in the request: true when any bought line counted in the cart total and budget has an estimated price (price_source 'estimate').

estimate_source.description: Only with a country in the request: where the estimated prices come from.

source.description: e.g. 'MAPA, Panel de consumo alimentario en hogares'.

period_from.description: YYYY-MM, first month of the average.

period_to.description: YYYY-MM, last month of the average.

built.description: YYYY-MM-DD the price table was built.

region.description: Only with a region in the request: its code, e.g. 'ES-MD'.

region_name.description: Only with a region in the request: e.g. 'Comunidad de Madrid'.

price_source.description: e.g. 'user' for a price the user typed, 'estimate' for a country's average price, 'typical' for a generic pack.

price_period.description: Estimated prices only: months of the average, 'YYYY-MM/YYYY-MM'.

price_region.description: Estimated prices only, with a region in the request: the region whose average priced this line (e.g. 'ES-MD'). Absent: the national average.

user_product.description: Only on lines from a product the user saved (request products): its pack size is the only option; price_source is 'user', 'estimate' (no price on the product, a country's estimate for its pack size) or null (unpriced).

MealNutrition.description: Macros computed by the engine, plus fiber (a food with no fiber value adds 0). fiber_g is optional so meals saved before it existed stay valid.

Micros.description: 10 micronutrients per serving vs EU reference intakes (Regulation (EU) 1169/2011, Annex XIII). Every eaten line adds the nutrients it has; a nutrient the source does not give counts as unknown, not 0. Lines under 2 g per serving (spices, salt) are left out of the ingredient counts and coverage.

nrv.description: EU nutrient reference value for adults, per day.

pct.description: per_serving as % of nrv, rounded half up.

at_least_15pct.description: Nutrients with pct of at least 15 (a significant amount in Annex XIII).

with_data.description: Counted ingredients with a value for all 10 nutrients.

total.description: Eaten lines of at least 2 g per serving.

missing.description: Names of counted ingredients missing at least one nutrient.

fiber_pct.description: Per-serving fiber as % of 25 g a day (EFSA adequate intake for adults), rounded half up.

source.description: e.g. ciqual, usda, open_food_facts, or label (nutrition from the user's saved product).
